command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify the staged 30x fixture against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 6949939b5937046f1ec7fdcc764dc47df5dd3c35d48b5487470ae3527d21b04a HG00096.chr20_2.0-2.4Mb.30x.bam > b.sha256
sha256sum -c b.sha256

echo "== bcftools mpileup+call, region-restricted; mpileup auto-builds chr20.fa.fai (no samtools needed) =="
bcftools mpileup -f chr20.fa -r chr20:2000000-2400000 HG00096.chr20_2.0-2.4Mb.30x.bam -Ou 2> bcf.log | bcftools call -mv -Oz -o bcftools.vcf.gz 2>> bcf.log
bcftools index -t bcftools.vcf.gz

# ---- per-tool ----
BTOTAL=$(bcftools view -H bcftools.vcf.gz | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
BCONF=$(bcftools view -H -i 'QUAL>=20' bcftools.vcf.gz | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

# ---- cross-code, LIKE WITH LIKE ----
# bcftools (pileup) and freebayes (haplotype) are different models; a raw VCF diff would
# fail by design. Normalise both (split multiallelics, left-align), restrict to CONFIDENT
# SNVs (QUAL>=20) -- SNVs because the two callers represent indels differently even after
# norm, so SNVs are the apples-to-apples set -- and assert Jaccard of POS:REF:ALT. The
# floor is what two correct callers should reach at 30x, not the observed value shaved.
bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m- bcftools.vcf.gz -Oz -o bcf.norm.vcf.gz 2>/dev/null
bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m- freebayes.vcf   -Oz -o fb.norm.vcf.gz  2>/dev/null
bcftools view -H -v snps -i 'QUAL>=20' bcf.norm.vcf.gz | awk '{print $2":"$4":"$5}' | sort -u > bcf.snv
bcftools view -H -v snps -i 'QUAL>=20' fb.norm.vcf.gz  | awk '{print $2":"$4":"$5}' | sort -u > fb.snv
I=$(comm -12 bcf.snv fb.snv | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
U=$(cat bcf.snv fb.snv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
JAC=$(awk -v i="$I" -v u="$U" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", (u>0)?i/u:0}')

{
  echo "variants_total          $BTOTAL  want 650..950   (observed 806)"
  echo "confident_QUAL>=20      $BCONF   want 710..880   (observed 797)"
  echo "snv_concordance_jaccard $JAC   want >= 0.85    (observed 0.9103; confident SNVs vs freebayes, I=$I U=$U)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$BTOTAL" -ge 650
test "$BTOTAL" -le 950
test "$BCONF"  -ge 710
test "$BCONF"  -le 880
awk -v j="$JAC" 'BEGIN{ if (j>=0.85) exit 0; print "snv concordance " j " below 0.85"; exit 1 }'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
